data.description:
## Problem

On 2026-11-13 the operator confirmed that rebar has no rule saying an agentic plan review that read no code is never signed. Change 3392 (`bf7d496eedc`, bug `bridal-gifted-vampirebat`) added that rule anyway. It came from an agent's reading of the epic's "Fail closed" invariant. That invariant covers runs that do not finish cleanly with schema-valid output. It says nothing about which tools the agent calls.

Today an agentic run that completes cleanly but makes no `read_file`, `search_files` or `list_directory` call resolves to an unsigned INDETERMINATE (`resolution_class` FIX_AGENT_DESIGN) instead of the verdict its findings produce.

Where the rule lives on origin/main:
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/gate_dispatch.py`, around line 249: the `agentic_unread_error` check and its early return through `_degraded_plan_review_verdict`.
- `src/rebar/llm/workflow/plan_review_recovery.py`:
  - `agentic_unread_error`, `_CODE_READ_TOOLS`;
  - `STEP_AGENTIC_REVIEW` added to the required step ids, which exists only to keep that check from being silently disabled.
- `docs/adr/0123-selectable-plan-review-engine.md` §3, around line 92: the "An agentic run that read no code ... is never signed (amended 2026-11-13 ...)" paragraph.
- Tests:
  - `tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic_verdict.py`, the section "an agent that read no code is never signed";
  - `tests/unit/test_plan_review_agentic.py`, the real-runner `_usage` code-read tests.

## Plan

Remove exactly what `bf7d496eedc` added, so behavior returns to what it was before that commit:
1. In `gate_dispatch.py`, remove the check and its early return.
2. In `plan_review_recovery.py`, remove `agentic_unread_error` and `_CODE_READ_TOOLS`. Restore the required step-id set to its pre-`bf7d496eedc` contents. Remove `STEP_AGENTIC_REVIEW` unless something other than the rule uses it.
3. In ADR 0123 §3, remove the paragraph. Add a dated 2026-11-13 amendment note saying it was withdrawn because the operator never decided it. Keep the existing "Fail closed" rule for failed runs unchanged.
4. Remove the rule's tests. Add a RED test showing that an agentic run which completes cleanly with zero `blocker` findings and no code-read calls PASSes and is signed.
5. Check the agentic success path is otherwise identical to its state at `aa1681bb531^` minus `bf7d496eedc`. A `git revert` of `bf7d496eedc`, resolved against the later ADR edits, is acceptable.

No config key, env var or flag. No other behavior change. The other fail-closed paths stay intact: errors, timeouts, limits, refusals and invalid output.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `git grep -n -iE 'agentic_unread|read no code|_CODE_READ_TOOLS' -- src docs tests` prints nothing.
- [ ] A test shows a clean agentic run with zero blocker findings and no code-read calls PASSes and is signed.
- [ ] The existing fail-closed tests for failed agentic runs still pass, unchanged.
- [ ] ADR 0123 carries a dated 2026-11-13 note withdrawing the rule.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
data.title: Remove the unrequested "agentic review that read no code is never signed" rule
